description_en: Override automatic shell detection. Useful when your login shell differs from your preferred working shell (for example, `bash` vs `zsh`)
description_ja: 自動検出されるシェルの代わりに、Claude Codeが使用する優先シェルを指定します。

related_changelog.content: - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX` for wrapping Claude and user-provided shell commands run by Claude Code
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL` environment variable to override automatic shell detection (useful when login shell differs from actual working shell)
